claims.statement: The conflict reference uses Copilot cloud-feature scope; neither actual entitlement nor GHES applicability follows.
Enterprise owners can delegate policy to organizations using the No policy choice, allowing conflicting organization-level choices among licensed seats.
Feature, model and privacy policy combination depends on the specific policy's restrictive rule, not one universal merge operation.
Under least-restrictive organization combination, any organization enabling the feature enables it for the licensed user everywhere.
Under most-restrictive organization combination, any organization disabling the feature disables it for the licensed user across organizations.
Copilot Metrics API uses most-restrictive organization combination; its information link is applicable only in the ghec branch.
Semantic indexing of non-GitHub repositories uses most-restrictive combination and requires every organization to explicitly enable it.
Unconfigured semantic-indexing policy behaves as disabled, not as implicit permission.
Public-code suggestion privacy policy uses most-restrictive organization combination.
Allowing unlicensed members to use GitHub.com Copilot code review uses most-restrictive organization combination.

AI credit paid usage is a multi-enterprise exception because it applies to each enterprise rather than the user.
Spark is explicitly listed as an exception to the usual most-restrictive multi-enterprise rule; this article does not specify an alternative universal merge rule.
Organization and enterprise policy-setting procedures are separate dependencies; linked procedures do not verify effective settings.
